title: CareCloud confirms 3.7M patients had their medical records stolen in data breach | TechCrunch
summary: Tech giant TriZetto confirmed in March that a 2024 data breach affected 3.4 million people’s data, and an as-yet-unspecified number of people have had their data stolen during a July data breach at healthtech billing software maker Craneware.
